After a review of pipeline design literature, a set of simple expressions have been selected to represent an approximation of the threshold pressure for failure from cross- sectional yielding, cross-section buckling, and longitudinal buckling. These expressions provide a first-order approximation on load levels needed to achieve collapse. As a demonstration, the collapse pressure for a set of representative pipelines are calculated. Estimated pressure fields are also computed for a set of nuclear detonations, providing estimates of the ground range limit for pipeline collapse. 3 ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS Thanks to Kevin Stamber, Andjelka Kelic, Walt Beyeler, and Alex Brown for their collaborations on this interesting project space.
